devdoc.details: When epoch is running no deposits or withdrawals are allowed. When epoch ends  lenders can request withdrawals, that will be fullfilled by the end of the next epoch. If the apr for the new epoch is lower than the last one, lenders can request 'instant'  withdrawals that will be fullfilled when the epoch starts and after instantWithdrawDelay (3 days). Funds for instant and normal withdrawals are sent to the strategy contract (IdleCreditVault)

params._limit: limit in underlying value, 0 means no limit

depositAA(uint256).details: msg.sender should approve this contract first to spend `_amount` of `token`

depositBB(uint256).details: msg.sender should approve this contract first to spend `_amount` of `token`

emergencyShutdown().details: can be called by both the owner and the guardian

returns._0: actual apr given current ratio between AA and BB tranches

getContractValue().details: unclaimed rewards (gov tokens) and `unclaimedFees` are not counted.  Harvested rewards are counted only if enough blocks have passed (`_lockedRewards`)

getCurrentAARatio().details: _virtualBalance is used to have a more accurate/recent value for the AA ratio because it calculates the balance after splitting the accrued interest since the last depositXX/withdrawXX/harvest

returns._0: AA tranches ratio (in underlying value) considering all interest

getFundsFromBorrower(uint256,uint256,uin.details: Get interest and funds for fullfill withdraw requests (normal and instant) from borrower, method is external so it can be used in the try/catch blocks

params._governanceFund: address where funds will be sent in case of emergency
params._owner: guardian address (can pause, unpause and call emergencyShutdown)

returns._0: true if wallet is allowed or keyring address is not set

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pause().details: can be called by both the owner and the guardian

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

restoreOperations().details: can be called by the owner only

setEpochParams(uint256,uint256).details: IMPORTANT: bufferPeriod should not be changed once set otherwise interest calculations will be wrong

params._aprDelta: min apr delta to trigger instant withdraw

params._active: flag to allow Adaptive Yield Split

params._isDisabled: true to disable deposits during an epoch

params._keyringAllowWithdraw: flag to allow anyone to request a withdraw

params._diffBps: tolerance in % (FULL_ALLOC = 100%) for socializing small losses

params._aprSplit: min apr split for AA, considering FULL_ALLOC = 100%

startEpoch().details: We calculate the total funds that the borrower should return at the end of the epoch ie interests + fees from normal withdraw requests. We send to the borrower underlyings amounts ie interests +  new deposits - instant withdraw requests if any. If funds are not enough to satisfy all requests then borrower should return the difference before instantWithdrawDeadline. After epoch start there should be no underlyings in this contract

stopEpoch(uint256,uint256).details: Only owner or manager can call this function. Borrower MUST approve this contract

params._interest: Interest gained in the epoch. This will overwrite the expected interest must be 0 if there is no need to overwrite the expected interest and if > 0 then it should be greater than the pending withdraw fees and newApr must be 0. If `_interest` is 1 then it is interpreted as a special case where we request everything back from the borrower
params._newApr: New apr to set for the next epoch

stopEpochWithDuration(uint256,uint256,ui.details: see stopEpoch and setEpochParams for more details, bufferPeriod is not modified

params._newApr: New apr to set for the next epoch

returns._0: tranche price, in underlyings, at the last interaction (not considering interest earned  since last interaction)

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._token: address of the token to transfer

unpause().details: can be called by both the owner and the guardian

params._amount: Amount of tranche tokens to write off

devdoc.title: IdleCDO variant that supports epochs.

allowAAWithdrawRequest().notice: flag to allow AA withdraw requests

allowBBWithdrawRequest().notice: flag to allow BB withdraw requests

bufferPeriod().notice: time between 2 epochs, can be set to 0 to start the next epoch without waiting a specified time

claimInstantWithdrawRequest().notice: Claim an instant withdraw request from the vault. Can be done when epoch is running as funds will get transferred from borrower when epoch starts

claimWithdrawRequest().notice: Claim a withdraw request from the vault. Can be done when at least 1 epoch passed since last withdraw request

defaulted().notice: flag to check if borrower defaulted

depositDuringEpoch(uint256,address).notice: Deposit during an active epoch with prorated interest

disableInstantWithdraw().notice: flag to completely disable instant withdraw

emergencyShutdown().notice: pause deposits and redeems for all classes of tranches

epochEndDate().notice: end date of the current epoch

expectedEpochInterest().notice: expected interest for the current epoch

getContractValue().notice: calculates the current net TVL (in `token` terms)

getCurrentAARatio().notice: calculates the current AA tranches ratio

getInstantWithdrawFunds().notice: Get funds from borrower to fullfill instant withdraw requests Manager should call this method after instantWithdrawDeadline (when epoch is running)

harvest(bool[],bool[],uint256[],uint256[.notice: NOTE: harvest is not performed to transfer funds to the strategy (startEpoch is used)

instantWithdrawAprDelta().notice: min apr change to trigger instant withdraw

instantWithdrawDeadline().notice: deadline to allow instant withdraw requests

instantWithdrawDelay().notice: delay to allow instant withdraw requests after next epoch starts

interestForOverUnderPerformance().notice: amount of over/under performance that withdrawal requests will cause

isDepositDuringEpochDisabled().notice: flag to disable deposits during an epoch

isEpochRunning().notice: flag to check if epoch is running

isWalletAllowed(address).notice: Check if wallet is allowed to interact with the contract

keyringAllowWithdraw().notice: flag for enabling anyone to request a withdraw (needed for liquidations)

lastEpochApr().notice: apr of the last epoch, unscaled

maxWithdrawable(address,address).notice: Get the max amount of underlyings that can be withdrawn by user

pendingWithdrawFees().notice: fees from pending withdraw request for the curr epoch

requestWithdraw(uint256,address).notice: Request a withdraw from the vault

restoreOperations().notice: allow deposits and redeems for all classes of tranches

sendFundsToBorrower(uint256).notice: workaround to have safeTransfer to borrower as external and use it in a try/catch block

setIsDepositDuringEpochDisabled(bool).notice: set flag to disable deposits during an epoch

setTrancheAPRSplitRatio(uint256).notice: NOTE: the vault is either a single tranche (ie all interest to senior and set in additionalInit) or AYS is active

setUnlentPerc(uint256).notice: NOTE: unlent perc should always be 0 and set in additionalInit

startEpoch().notice: Start the epoch. No deposits or withdrawals are allowed after this.

stopEpoch(uint256,uint256).notice: Stop epoch, accrue interest to the vault and get funds to fullfill normal (ie non-instant) withdraw requests from the prev epoch.

stopEpochWithDuration(uint256,uint256,ui.notice: Stop epoch and set new duration

transferToken(address,uint256).notice: Emergency method, tokens gets transferred to the governanceRecoveryFund address

updateAccounting().notice: this method updates the accounting of the contract and effectively splits the yield/loss between the AA and BB tranches. This can be called at any time as is called automatically on each deposit/redeem. It's here just to be called when a default happened, as deposits/redeems are paused, but we need to update the loss for junior holders

virtualPrice(address).notice: calculates the current tranches price considering the interest/loss that is yet to be splitted ie the interest/loss generated since the last update of priceAA and priceBB (done on depositXX/withdrawXX/harvest)

withdrawAA(uint256).notice: NOTE: normal withdraw are not allowed

writeOffDeposit(uint256,address).notice: Write off the deposit, this will be used if the borrower and a lender comes to an off-chain agreement so here we burn tranche tokens, the equivalent amount of strategy tokens. Only the borrower can call this
